text: I only hope we'll have enough space for
all of them. Yes, Dee hopes so too. But
if you do run out of room, Madame Peek
at Brood and Peek in Hogsme will help to
find safe homes for them. Any beasts the
room can't hold? Yes, she's well known
for helping to care for beasts in need,
and she'll give you a fair price for
them. Okay, we can sell those. Okay.
Beasts that are wellfed and groomed will
provide you with valuable magical
materials, such as puff skin hair, for
example. If you gather some magical
materials from your beasts, we can show
you how to use them. How to use? Very
well. I shall let you know when I have
some. Yes.
I need I feed you guys.
No. Time to feed
you. Wonderful.
